# TypeScript Core Full Guide

Use this guide for strict typing strategy and type-system scalability.

## Scope

- Compiler strictness and config
- Advanced type patterns
- Runtime validation boundaries
- Type defect triage workflows

## Core Playbook

1. Enforce strict config baselines.
2. Keep public contracts explicit.
3. Pair runtime parsing with inferred types.
4. Resolve type errors with minimal complexity growth.
